title: HAL test: Add duty cycle UINT32_MAX duration boundary test
description: The duty cycle tests verify behavior when duration exceeds budget by 1ms (line 1357), but do not test with dur=UINT32_MAX. While the implementation handles this via uint64_t promotion, the edge case should be explicitly tested to prevent regressions.
close_reason: Fixed: Added UINT32_MAX duration boundary test to both C HAL tests (main.c:1449-1451) and Rust duty_cycle tests. Tests verify implementation correctly returns u64::MAX for impossible durations via uint64_t promotion.
